caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic cup with a slightly flared rim and a single, rounded handle. The cup features a decorative design divided vertically: the left section shows part of a white panel with the top of a sailing ship and partial gold-text lettering ending in “assa.”, bordered on the right with an ornate gold edge; the right section is filled with a solid, crackled sky-blue color. The cup’s rim is lined with a thin gold band, and the base is thick and also colored in a reflective gold. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the cup in the center. The lower left corner of the image contains small, faint text.
title: Shaving Mug
